verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office and incorporation platform, so API parity with the UI is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents a public API. Every capability cited is delivered through the dashboard or app UI, and probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
